rows: Equipment: Electronic speed governor ETR20-DEPRETTO ESCHERWYSS, Italian

This document sets out the annual maintenance steps for the electronic speed governor. The first draft of the document was prepared by Eng. Hassan Moussa Hassan at Esna Power Station and field-tested by Eng. Ramadan Farrag Ahmed, endorsed by Eng. Mohamed Nasr El-Din Ahmed: Electrical Maintenance Department Manager at the station, approved by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Ali: General Manager of Esna Power Station, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Osama Suleiman Selim: General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Hydro Power Stations Company for Electricity Generation and MPIS Coordinator.
Issue an approved work permit; maintenance personnel must hold the occupational safety and health category card
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions and procedures, e.g. wearing a safety helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Make sure the work area is marked out and the appropriate warning signs are posted
The unit is out of service and in Test mode
Coordinate with the mechanical maintenance department
Clean the cabinet cards using the blower
Check all fans and replace any faulty one
Visually check the condition of the cards and replace any faulty one
Check the signals in coordination with the various departments
Check the pressure control switch settings in the spherical tank
Use the extension card for the guide vane and runner blade opening/closing commands when requested by mechanical maintenance
Measure the various power supply voltages and adjust them as per the table
